Soma là ứng dụng học giải phẫu trong khu: Soma is an anatomy learning application developed as a graduation project. Models, annotations and questions support self-study and do not replace a doctor’s diagnosis, advice or treatment.
Bạn chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ tài khoản củ: You are responsible for protecting your account. Your account, study plan, history and review queue are shared with Soma on the web when using the same server. Practice scores are for self-assessment and are not professional certification.
Mô hình có nguồn từ Atlas BodyParts3D và: Models originate from BodyParts3D and Z-Anatomy. Reuse must retain attribution and comply with each source’s license. See Sources and licenses in Profile. Do not present this application as an official medical authority.
Atlas có dữ liệu đi kèm ứng dụng. Đăng n: Atlas data is bundled with the application. Sign-in, submission and sync require a running server. Drafts and bookmarks are stored on the device, separately by server and account, and may be lost when app data is cleared or the app is removed. If submission fails, keep the attempt and use retry.
Nếu phát hiện nội dung thiếu hoặc sai, v: To report missing or incorrect content, send the model, structure or question name and app version to trinhviethoangawm@gmail.com. Do not send passwords or sign-in codes.
Khi tạo hoặc đăng nhập tài khoản, ứng dụ: When creating or signing into an account, the app exchanges credentials, name, email and profile details with the configured Soma server. If you choose Google, GitHub or Facebook, authentication involves that provider and the Soma server; the provider’s policy also applies.
Lộ trình, câu trả lời được nộp, kết quả,: Your study plan, submitted answers, results, study duration and review schedule are sent to the server for grading and web sync. Drafts and bookmarks are stored separately on the device by server and account.
Trên Android, thông tin phiên được giữ b: On Android, session credentials are kept in SecureStore. The browser preview keeps sessions only in tab memory. The app does not store your password for later sign-in. Signing out removes the device session and does not automatically delete your account, history or drafts.
Bản mobile này không sử dụng camera, mic: This mobile app does not use the camera, microphone or image scanning. Account features and sync require Internet access. Development builds can connect to a local HTTP server; production builds require HTTPS. Only configure a server you trust.
Câu hỏi và tối đa bốn tin nhắn gần nhất: Your question and up to four recent messages are sent to the Soma server. When AI is enabled, the server sends relevant context to its configured AI provider. The conversation remains only in screen memory and is cleared when you leave the screen or sign out. Personal documents are not automatically sent to the assistant. Do not include personal health information. Responses are for learning and include references.
Để phản hồi, yêu cầu sửa hoặc xóa dữ liệ: To give feedback or request account data correction or deletion, contact trinhviethoangawm@gmail.com from your account email. Requests are handled by the administrator; the app does not yet have automatic account deletion. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes device data only, not server data.
Điện thoại cần dùng địa chỉ LAN hoặc HTT: Your phone needs the server’s LAN address or HTTPS URL. Changing servers signs you out of the current account.
Atlas BodyParts3D 4.0 © The Database Cen: Atlas BodyParts3D 4.0 © The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0. GLB scenes use Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D with original attribution and CC-BY-SA licensing. The app shares the same assets as Soma on the web.
Terminologia Anatomica và chú giải đã bi: Terminologia Anatomica and annotations compiled in the Soma library. Names, notes and questions come from public content published through the management system.
Câu hỏi về cấu trúc và tên Latin được dẫ: Structure and Latin-name questions are derived from the model annotations. Each question retains a stable structure identifier to share its review schedule with the web.
Ứng dụng phục vụ học tập giải phẫu. Nội: This application supports anatomy learning. Content missing from the library is clearly identified on screen.
